results.title: Too Many Beasts
results.overview: In the French countryside, wild boars ravaging crops spark an open war between farmers and members of a gentlemen’s hunting club, who feed the game between hunts. Brun, a bankrupt farmer, struggles to keep his farm afloat. When the club’s president pushes him to his limits, Brun shoots him and disappears. A year later, Fulda, a volatile police officer just transferred to the region, leads the investigation. Still struggling after a recent breakup, and as wild boars proliferate across the region, he is pushed to the brink of sanity.

results.title: Butterfly Jam
results.overview: 16 years old Pyteh splits his time between the wrestling mat and his family’s struggling Circassian diner in Newark. A single impulsive decision by his hustling father changes the course of his life, shaping a tale of pride, legacy, and masculinity.

results.title: Golem
results.overview: The village idiot lives in a hut with his sick mother. His neighbors are the Jewish family of the local blacksmith Mendel, and the guy is secretly in love with his youngest daughter Sonya.

results.title: The Victorians
results.overview: In the gritty underbelly of Amsterdam, a band of rogues scheme against one another as they prey on unsuspecting tourists. While Abba fights his obsession with the sadist Danny, his romantically naive brother, Rey, falls for the femme fatale, Faith. Masquerading as a tour guide, Danny enjoys luring tourists into his sadistic web, while Virgil, the deviant hotel owner, is there to help pick up the pieces. Alfi, the devious junkie, remains Abba's faithful liege, but the worm might turn if promises of taking him to Spain go unfulfilled. The fragile balance of their alliance falls apart when a cocky American enters the fray.

results.title: Kuris-Kuris
results.overview: Toto and his Tatay both share the same dreams of finding success for their family. However, they have very different ideas of how to reach it. How will they reconcile their love for each other and their willingness for self-sacrifice?

results.title: Hånden på Hjertet
results.overview: HÅNDEN PÅ HJERTET is a psychological drama about family man KARL (40), who on paper has it all: a wife, a child and a respected job as a schoolteacher on a quiet island. But beneath the surface, he is losing touch with himself. Driven by a fragile self-image and a growing unease, he begins to act against the very life he has built. What starts as an attempt to hold on to control escalates into a spiral in which Karl will do anything to save the story of himself – even if it means others have to bear the consequences.

results.title: The Trap Door: Berk vs The Evil Dead
results.original_title: The Trap Door: Berk vs The Evil Dead
results.overview: Berk travels to a cabin in the woods for a holiday, but after mistaking the Necronomicon for a cook book, he awakens an ancient evil. Now, IT'S BONKIN' TIME.

results.title: Static
results.overview: After a sudden solar storm disables technology across the globe, a young woman and her estranged father are trapped in an isolated farmhouse.

results.title: We Are Wild
results.overview: When a young abused housewife runs away from home she finds herself in a 1970’s utopia in the woods with a ragtag group of misfit hippies. Is she free or did she give up one prison for another?

results.title: Charmed
results.overview: Fed up with the pressures of their senior year of high school, best-friends Stella and Fiadh remember their childhood favourite novel, 'The Map to Myrtle', and decide to embark on a journey to the fictional world of Myrtle Valley in search of the Magic Charm of Eternal Youth. However, they quickly discovered that everything in this surreal land was not quite as it seemed.

results.title: Ruhaani Ishq
results.overview: Ruhaani Ishq is a passionate love story where love faces family conflicts, rivalry and fate, taking two hearts through romance, sacrifice, heartbreak and unforgettable moments.

results.title: Give Me Something Good
results.overview: During a Halloween party, a group of young adults accidentally unleashes something dark and wicked. Now trapped inside a house, they must stay hidden until morning.

results.title: Au nom de Jésus - Brésil, le pouvoir des évangéliques
results.original_title: Au nom de Jésus - Brésil, le pouvoir des évangéliques

results.title: Not Just Me
results.overview: A young couple attends a family dinner where no one dares speak the truth.

results.title: CHAPS
results.overview: When a holiday heist goes sideways, a reckless crew drags their rookie runner into a chaotic game of cops, robbers, and betrayal. As the night spirals further out of control, one bad deal could turn their first big hustle into their last.

results.title: Mother
results.overview: One night, while Nicolás and Valentina care for their ill mother, the stress, anxiety, and distress caused by her declining health lead to a serious argument in which they both finally express what they have been keeping to themselves.

results.title: Dokument inifrån: Pojkarna - regissören och sanningen
results.original_title: Dokument inifrån: Pojkarna - regissören och sanningen
results.overview: He was the acclaimed film director who had the voice of the youth and the ear of the powerful. His fall from grace was steep when he was accused of, and admitted to, sexually abusing a 13-year-old boy who had appeared in his films. In this documentary series, journalist Negra Efendić seeks the truth about Staffan Hildebrand.
